subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Produzir textos (infográficos, fóruns de discussão on-line, fotorreportagens, campanhas publicitárias, memes, entre outros) sobre temas de interesse coletivo local ou global, que revelem posicionamento crítico.

components.description_pt: Identificar propósito comunicativo de textos multimodais como infográficos, memes e ensaios fotográficos
components.description_en: Identify the communicative purpose of multimodal texts such as infographics, memes, and photo essays
components.cc_component_description: Identify the purpose of information presented in visual, quantitative, or oral media formats

components.description_pt: Selecionar gênero textual apropriado para comunicar posição sobre questão coletiva local ou global
components.description_en: Select a text genre appropriate to communicate a position on a local or global collective issue
components.cc_component_description: Select an organizational structure appropriate to the task, purpose, and audience

components.description_pt: Construir texto multimodal que expresse posicionamento crítico claramente definido sobre tema coletivo
components.description_en: Construct a multimodal text that expresses a clearly defined critical stance on a collective topic
components.cc_component_description: Construct an informative or explanatory text that examines complex ideas and information

components.description_pt: Integrar elementos verbais e visuais coerentemente para apoiar argumento crítico em texto produzido
components.description_en: Integrate verbal and visual elements coherently to support a critical argument in a produced text
components.cc_component_description: Integrate visual, audio, or interactive elements strategically to clarify reasoning and evidence

components.description_pt: Avaliar relevância e impacto de texto produzido para sua audiência pretendida e contexto de circulação
components.description_en: Evaluate the relevance and impact of a produced text for its intended audience and context of circulation
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how the choice of medium influences the clarity and impact of information

cc_matches.description: Analyze the purpose of information presented in diverse media and formats (e.g., visually, quantitatively, orally) and evaluate the motives (e.g., social, commercial, political) behind its presentation.
Write informative/explanatory texts to examine and convey complex ideas and information clearly and accurately through the effective selection, organization, and analysis of content.

Make strategic use of digital media (e.g., textual, graphical, audio, visual, and interactive elements) in presentations to enhance understanding of findings, reasoning, and evidence and to add interest.
Produce clear and coherent writing in which the development, organization, and style are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.
Evaluate the advantages and disadvantages of using different mediums (e.g., print or digital text, video, multimedia) to present a particular topic or idea.
